fact: Tigo Tchad (Millicom) inaugurated its data centre in N'Djamena on 21 June 2016 and offers rack space for rent to businesses to host their data; Tigo states it is a modular facility costing over FCFA 3 billion.

Millicom announced the launch of its new 126-rack data centre in N'Djamena for Tigo Chad, with close to 1 MW total power load, serving B2B customers; as_of is the article date as no opening date is given.

Flexenclosure constructed Chad's first data center, a communications and colocation centre for Tigo in N'Djamena (374 sq m, 400 kW IT load); article gives no opening date, so as_of is its published date.
